critical_safety.tolerance: zero excess critical failures versus the paired baseline; report a 95% upper bound when none observed

acceptance.margin_justification: Tasks are advisory or local-implementation steps whose errors are caught later by owner review; 5 points is the largest loss judged tolerable. Safety-relevant behaviour is NOT covered by this margin (see critical_safety).
acceptance.per_task: deterministic grader (harness/grade.py) against frozen answer keys; worker self-scores and Jev decisions are never labels

accounting_boundary.unit: provider-reported USD when present; otherwise reconstructed from pricing-snapshot.json and labelled estimated; never both for one request
accounting_boundary.unknown_rule: any unknown generative usage in an attempt makes that attempt ineligible for complete-cost claims

analysis.clustering: repetitions nested within task; bootstrap resamples tasks

arm_notes: D reproduces the installed policy (repo HEAD 327c36b == installed skill) including host scope classification and its short Luna-low path; only the transport differs (OpenRouter instead of codex exec), which is recorded as a deliberate difference.
D0 isolates the instrumentation-only candidate changes; it must match D on decisions.

The original mandatory semantic-gate concept (Sol-high after every unit) is historical (research/live-gpt6-fixture) and is not re-run here; bypass variants (A, B) never count as evidence that mandatory gating helps.
attribution: CIDM (Caber Interstitial Decision Mesh) is attributed in this project to Kenneth Vic A. Caber (repository byline; earlier files use "Kenneth A. Caber"). This study makes no claim about scientific priority or patentability.

budget.reservation: worst case = request bytes as input tokens at the max(input, cache_write) rate + max_output_tokens at the output rate
budget.unbounded_rule: a request whose worst case cannot be bounded is refused

exclusions: none post hoc; failed, refused, timed-out and budget-exhausted attempts are outcomes
a harness defect discovered mid-study voids and re-runs ALL arms for the affected tasks, reported in RESULTS.md

execution.cache_conditions: Not controlled beyond ordering; provider cache clears are not claimed. cached/cache-write tokens are recorded per call and reported by arm.
execution.identity: provider route pinned (azure), fallbacks disallowed; any returned model/provider mismatch fails the attempt
execution.workspace: fresh temporary directory and fresh process per attempt

primary.claim_requires: accepted_rate non-inferior (lower 95% bound of D-A >= -margin) AND cost_per_accepted saving >= minimum_useful_saving with a 95% interval excluding 0 AND zero excess critical failures AND latency within limits

secondary.question: does Jev routing beat a static cascade?

secondary.note: combined; does not attribute the effect to a component

hypothesis.statement: Interposing structured Jev decisions between consequential task transitions, while selecting sufficient model-and-effort routes and transferring task-relevant context, reduces end-to-end cost and/or expensive-model usage without unacceptable loss of quality, safety, or latency.

mock.purpose: harness validation only; accuracies are arbitrary and are NOT evidence about any arm

population.description: Bounded project tasks of the kinds the installed skill is used for: short sourced answers, deterministic extraction/arithmetic, context-dependent recommendations, implementation/debugging, multi-file review, long-context synthesis. Fixtures are fictional analogues of the project's work.
population.lineage_rule: development and held-out tasks never share a lineage (enforced by build_fixtures.py)
population.sampling: all held-out tasks, every preregistered arm, interleaved random arm order per (task, repetition)

power_and_repetition.consequence: The fixture set supports a PILOT only (variance estimation, harness validation). Any live result on it is exploratory and cannot establish non-inferiority. Repetitions of one task are not independent tasks.
power_and_repetition.expansion_rule: scale held-out tasks using the pilot's observed discordance and log-cost SD before any claim

status: preregistered; mock smoke test only; NO live provider runs executed
stopping_rules: any provider identity or route mismatch (fail closed, investigate)
